question: Which 3 players won the most player awards? List their full name and id.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name_first ,  T1.name_last ,  T1.player_id FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.player_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3;
pred_sql:
SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.name_given AS full_name
FROM
    player_award pa
JOIN
    player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY
    p.player_id,
    p.name_given
ORDER BY
    COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 3
